env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^const groups ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constgroups

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type count int

const (
	_ = iota
	fileSlice = []int{7, 8}
	fileIndex = iota
	fileNext
	fileTyped count = iota
	fileTypedNext
	fileRune = 'A' + iota
	fileRuneNext
)

func ordinary() {
	const (
		first = iota
		localSlice = []int{9}
		index = iota
		next
	)
	if first != 0 || index != 2 || next != 3 || localSlice[0] != 9 {
		panic("ordinary const group")
	}
}

func main() {
	if fileIndex != 2 || fileNext != 3 || fileTyped != 4 || fileTypedNext != 5 || fileRune != 'G' || fileRuneNext != 'H' {
		panic("file const group")
	}
	if fileSlice[0] != 7 || fileSlice[1] != 8 {
		panic("file composite")
	}
	if fmt.Sprintf("%T %T %T %T", fileIndex, fileNext, fileRune, fileRuneNext) != "int int int32 int32" {
		panic("file inferred types")
	}
	if fmt.Sprintf("%T %T", fileTyped, fileTypedNext) != "main.count main.count" {
		panic("file named types")
	}
	ordinary()
	fmt.Println("const groups ok")
}
